speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are here because you have sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; please tell me exactly where this pain starts and how it travels. On a scale of 0 to 10, how severe is the pain, and does it get worse when you cough, sneeze, or change your position?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sciatica (likely due to acute lumbar disc herniation). The sudden onset during exercise with radiation to the foot is classic; however, given the acute nature, I will not perform further questioning. Please proceed with a lumbar MRI to confirm disc pathology and rule out cauda equina syndrome. REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar MRI.
